review.notes: Full re-review. Both findings and all corrections of the first review are repaired. Seeded sample (1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 1.4, 2.2, 2.3, 2.4, 2.5, 2.7, 3.4, 4.1, 4.3, 5.1, 5.2, 6.2) and every other statement recomputed numerically from the Lean definitions for d <= 6: none failed. 12 DLMF locators checked against the text; the six books (Edmonds, Vilenkin-Klimyk, Klimyk-Vilenkin, Wawrzynczyk, Dieudonne, Miller) could not be read legally. Suggested.lean elaborates at the pins with 68 sorry warnings only; dependency check: 0 problems; one-tactic probe on 10 theorems, 1 closes. Findings: R01 (P2) the L2(S2) decomposition of 6.3 uses Measure.toSphere while the cited suppliers use the Riemannian volume, with no comparison owned; R02 (P2) the zonal spherical function classification, a Summary headline, is statable at the pins and absent from Suggested.lean. One automatic form check (section comment over the #check block) set aside as a false positive.
